title: Breezy Bliss | KEY.co
description_expanded: Breezy Bliss, nestled in the vibrant Watersound community of Prominence, FL, offers the perfect blend of luxury and comfort for your next vacation. This charming three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom home is designed to provide all the conveniences of home, featuring a spacious living area with a smart TV and queen sleeper sofa, a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar, and modern amenities like a full-size washer/dryer and free high-speed Wi-Fi. The master bedroom boasts a king bed and en suite bathroom, while additional bedrooms include a queen bed and a bunk bed, each with its own smart TV. With a pet-friendly policy, a six-seater golf cart, and four bikes included, Breezy Bliss ensures a delightful stay for the entire family. Located just steps from The Big Chill, Breezy Bliss places guests at the heart of Prominence's vibrant town center, renowned for its entertainment options, eateries, and boutique shops. Enjoy concerts, family activities, and movie nights on the green, all within a five-minute walk. Prominence itself is one of the most popular communities along Scenic 30A, featuring resort-style pools, open green spaces, and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Centrally positioned between Seagrove, Seaside, Alys, and Rosemary Beach, this vacation home offers unparalleled convenience to both new and long-time 30A attractions, making it the ideal destination for creating unforgettable memories.
